name: Preisänderungen Lieferantenartikel
description: Zeigt Änderungen der Einkaufspreise für Lieferantenartikel einschließlich relativer Abweichung.
export_instructions: In SilverERP Controlling / Gesp. Abfragen / Preise öffnen und die angezeigte Liste als CSV exportieren.
query:
WITH prepared AS (
        SELECT *,
          CAST(`Zeitpunkt` AS BIGINT) AS silver_timestamp,
          (CAST(`Zeitpunkt` AS DOUBLE) - 7900000000000) / 1000000000 AS x
        FROM data
        WHERE `Typ` = 'supplierArticle'
      )
      SELECT
        `Artikel-Nr.` || chr(10) || `Bezeichnung 1` AS 'Artikel',
        `Referenz` AS 'Lieferant',
        STRFTIME(
          TIMESTAMP '2000-01-01 00:00:00'
            + (14.2926176 * POWER(x, 4) + 1546.80544 * POWER(x, 3) - 26762.5368 * POWER(x, 2) + 7762978.55 * x + 669577867) * INTERVAL '1 second',
          '%d.%m.%Y %H:%M'
        ) AS 'Zeitpunkt',
        `Benutzer`,
        REPLACE(PRINTF('%.4f', CAST(REPLACE(`Preis`, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE)), '.', ',') || chr(10) || REPLACE(PRINTF('%.4f', CAST(REPLACE(`Preis`, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE) * 1.11), '.', ',') AS 'Preis alt',
        REPLACE(PRINTF('%.4f', CAST(REPLACE(`Preis neu`, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE)), '.', ',') || chr(10) || REPLACE(PRINTF('%.4f', CAST(REPLACE(`Preis neu`, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE) * 1.11), '.', ',') AS 'Preis neu',
        CASE
          WHEN CAST(REPLACE(`Preis`, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE) = 0 THEN '–'
          ELSE REPLACE(PRINTF('%+.2f %%', (CAST(REPLACE(`Preis neu`, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE) / CAST(REPLACE(`Preis`, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE) - 1) * 100), '.', ',')
        END AS 'Rel. Änderung',
        CASE
          WHEN CAST(REPLACE(`Preis neu`, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE) > CAST(REPLACE(`Preis`, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE) THEN 'up'
          WHEN CAST(REPLACE(`Preis neu`, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE) < CAST(REPLACE(`Preis`, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE) THEN 'down'
          ELSE 'same'
        END AS 'Änderungsrichtung'
      FROM prepared
      ORDER BY silver_timestamp DESC, `Artikel-Nr.`
